prompts.label: ambient
prompts.prompt: Continuous, low-level urban background noise with no dominant acoustic events

prompts.label: wind
prompts.prompt: Wind noise and turbulent gusts blowing against the recording microphone outdoors

prompts.label: traffic
prompts.prompt: A standard passenger car driving past on an asphalt street with tire roll sound

prompts.label: revving
prompts.prompt: A loud car accelerating with high-RPM engine revving and exhaust backfiring pops

prompts.label: motorcycle
prompts.prompt: A loud motorcycle driving past with an aggressive, buzzing exhaust roar

prompts.label: truck
prompts.prompt: A heavy diesel truck or bus rumbling past with deep low-frequency engine vibrations

prompts.label: speech
prompts.prompt: Human voices speaking and conversing outdoors

prompts.label: birds
prompts.prompt: Birds chirping, singing, or calling from trees in a city park or street

prompts.label: siren
prompts.prompt: An emergency vehicle siren wailing in urban traffic

prompts.label: horn
prompts.prompt: A vehicle horn honking loudly in a city street

prompts.label: impact
prompts.prompt: A sharp metallic bang, dumpster lid slam, or construction clatter
